title: Complaint disposal
description: Disposal of complaint by District Commission

steps.step: Receipt of notice by opposite party
Decision on complaint within 3 months if no analysis or testing of commodities is required
Decision on complaint within 5 months if analysis or testing of commodities is required
Adjournment may be granted if sufficient cause is shown and reasons are recorded in writing
District Commission makes orders on costs occasioned by adjournment as per regulations
Recording of reasons in writing for disposal of complaint after specified period
